first_public_date_evidence: Bibliographic public-date record for Taft DOI 10.1073/pnas.68.11.2631 lists 1971-11-01; PubMed independently records the November 1971 issue. The exact first dissemination day beyond this published bibliographic date is not established.
integrity: Proof uses complete case classification and exact field-independent ranks. Tests over fields of orders two, three, four, and five are corroborating checks, not proof of the infinite field family. Originality remains subject to independent literature audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the nine-dimensional three-cycle algebra truncated at paths of length three. The Taft specialization requires the ground field to contain a primitive cube root. No general all-dimension rank theorem, Hopf adjoint-action spectrum, or commutator-fiber classification is claimed. Earlier general centralizer literature may remain unindexed.
title: Adjoint-rank spectrum of the three-cycle Loewy-three algebra and the nine-dimensional Taft algebra
